summary.text: Ke Xin Hong is a mushroomman Gu Immortal from Mushroomman Paradise who wears a white shirt, has a plain face, and does not conceal his appearance, with a large mushroom above his head looking like a hat.

claims.text: A mushroomman Gu Immortal approaches Wu Yong from the southeast, riding waves, and names himself. The Gu Immortals around Wu Yong take him for someone from Mushroomman Paradise. He transmits that he comes from Mushroomman Paradise carrying the orders of Gu Yue Fang Yuan, and smiles as he names Sheng Tian true inheritance.
He wears a white shirt and has a plain face. He does not conceal his appearance. There is a large mushroom above his head, looking like a hat.

Wu Yong stays calm while they exchange words. He is a Gu Immortal expert of Mushroomman Paradise. After Lu Wei Yin submitted to Fang Yuan along with the entire paradise, he became Fang Yuan’s subordinate, and this is the first mission Fang Yuan gave him. He had heard of Wu Yong’s name long ago and felt internal pressure on the way, thinking through refusal. Wu Yong agrees so readily that he is stunned, then understands his lord’s might and prestige.

He adds that his lord is willing to pay for the entire Sheng Tian true inheritance. Wu Yong asks for a rank nine wind path immortal material. He cannot decide alone, communicates with Fang Yuan, then smiles again. Through treasure yellow heaven the transaction completes: Fang Yuan obtains the full details of Sheng Tian true inheritance, and Wu Yong obtains the material.

Even though the mushroomman blessed land has not been annexed, most of these mushroommen have already relocated into Fang Yuan’s sovereign immortal aperture. He is the strongest Gu Immortal among them, and his poison path methods are extraordinary.
Among the mushroomman Gu Immortals who join Fang Yuan, he is the strongest.

He flies through the clouds over Southern Border on a mandatory diplomatic mission to Wu clan, communicating with a friend by information path Immortal Gu. He explains contribution points and the assisted tribulation task, and names Shi Zong as someone thriving. He is confident Wu Yong will not harm him even if the trip fails, because of his master’s power and influence. He descends at Wu Yi Mountain. Wu Ba Chong welcomes him as envoy. He asks to get down to business first, waits, then tells Wu Yong he comes with his master’s sincerity for another transaction: to buy the Hu Land in Wu clan’s possession.

Wu Ba Chong denies it. He smiles and does not refute, looking only at Wu Yong. The offered price is that Fang Yuan will personally refine the rank eight Immortal Gu Eight-faced Prestige Wind. He says Wu clan excels in wind path and that its only qi path foundation is in Sheng Tian true inheritance, so Hu Land has little value for them. When Wu Ba Chong argues qi path prospects, he answers that the prerequisite is possessing Hu Land. He bows and says that if Wu clan is not satisfied they will refine three rank eight Immortal Gu, that this is the bottom line, and that he is only a messenger and cannot make decisions. Wu Yong calls him an excellent messenger, agrees, and has Wu Ba Chong bring him to take Hu Land and send rank seven fan wind Gu as well.

When his message arrives, Fang Yuan uses Heaven and Earth Travel, moving from Eastern Sea to Southern Border and appearing in front of him. Fang Yuan puts him in the sovereign immortal aperture and returns to Eastern Sea with Hu Land.

At Wu Yi Mountain he greets Wu clan’s first supreme elder with a faint smile. He says he came with fan wind Gu, already refined and raised. Wu Yong has it examined: it is a genuine rank eight Immortal Gu. He asks which two Immortal Gu the clan wants refined next, so he can bring them both back. Wu Ba Chong notes this is the third time he has come to Wu clan. He agrees to stay, says he likes Wu clan’s style, and offers another transaction: Fang Yuan will refine rank eight Immortal Gu in exchange for Wu clan’s famous mountains.

Wu Ba Chong calls that an attempt to cripple Wu clan’s foundation. He answers calmly that Wu clan gained only six new immortals from recent ascensions, most external members, and cannot defend its territory, so selling some territories would leave higher ranked Immortal Gu and sufficient manpower. Immortal Gu are unique and hard to buy even in treasure yellow heaven. He adds that Human Smoke Mountain, Chai clan’s headquarters, was sold to them recently, then steps back: if Wu clan does not want the trade they will not force it, and he still needs to find other clans.

In Green Lotus Great World, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch and Xiao He Jian send one person to test the enemy: he cultivates poison path and is the strongest expert of the mushroomman Gu Immortals. They do not choose their own members. The mushroommen joined Fang Yuan last and have not joined the current major factions, so the seniors target them. Many people are jealous of him. He has had the most envoy missions, almost the sole beneficiary of missions that gain huge rewards by talking.

He steps forward with soaring fighting spirit. After those envoy missions he has animosity to answer in combat, and he wants the mushroomman tribe to become the number one faction among Fang Yuan’s subordinates so he can protect his tribesmen. He has already expected Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch and Xiao He Jian to ostracize him. He cups his fists and names himself, asking to exchange pointers.

Fairy Ming Hao names herself, says she knows about him, and asks whether his poison path method is used like this. Yellowish brown poisonous fluid flies out, each lump turning into a goose, until an army of poisonous geese dances in the sky and changes formation. He is shocked: this is his uniquely created method. He uses the same poison path killer move, then the variation: after the geese form, they cry out, and poison seeps out wherever their voices reach. After a few breaths she activates that variation as well and makes her own geese group cry out.
